phases.name: cargo fmt
phases.command: cargo fmt --check -p citry_core_py -p citry_html_transform -p citry_i18n -p citry_template_formatter -p citry_template_parser -p python_safe_eval

phases.name: cargo clippy
phases.command: cargo clippy --no-deps -p citry_core_py -p citry_html_transform -p citry_i18n -p citry_template_formatter -p citry_template_parser -p python_safe_eval --all-targets -- -D warnings

phases.name: cargo test
phases.command: cargo test -p citry_core_py -p citry_html_transform -p citry_i18n -p citry_template_formatter -p citry_template_parser -p python_safe_eval

phases.name: mypy
phases.command: uv run --no-sync mypy packages/py/citry/citry packages/py/citry/tests/test_events_typing.py packages/py/citry/tests/test_library_component_typing.py packages/py/citry_lsp/citry_lsp packages/py/citry_ui/citry_ui packages/py/citry_ui/tests/typing_contract.py packages/py/citry_core/citry_core packages/py/pygments_citry/pygments_citry scripts

phases.name: protocol contracts
phases.command: uv run --no-sync python -m packages.protocol._tooling.check packages/protocol/events/v1 packages/protocol/client_graph/v1

phases.name: pytest
phases.command: uv run --no-sync pytest -m not e2e and not qualification -n 4 --dist loadfile --durations 30 --cov --cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered

phases.name: pytest qualification
phases.command: uv run --no-sync pytest -m qualification and not e2e -n 2 --dist loadfile --durations 30
